provenance.source: NECB 2020 Division B: Tables 3.2.2.2 (opaque), 3.2.2.3 (fenestration/skylights), 3.2.3.1 (ground), Article 3.2.1.4 (FDWR formula + skylight cap) — retrieved via the building-codes MCP server (necb:2020) and cross-checked cell-by-cell against legacy openstudio-standards NECB2020/data/surface_thermal_transmittance.json (exact match, incl. door row refs PCF 1536/1537)
provenance.note: Runtime never contacts the MCP. U-values are EFFECTIVE transmittance per 3.1.1.7 (thermal bridging included) — see P3b/TBD integration.

fdwr.text: FDWR = 0.40 for HDD <= 4000; FDWR = (2000 - 0.2 x HDD)/3000 for 4000 < HDD < 7000; FDWR = 0.20 for HDD >= 7000
fdwr.boundary_note: Code text says <= 4000 -> 0.40; legacy openstudio-standards uses < 4000 with the linear branch at exactly 4000 — identical result ((2000-800)/3000 = 0.40).

srr_max.text: The total skylight area shall be less than 2% of the gross roof area

hdd_bins_note: keys are HDD bin CEILINGS {3000,4000,5000,6000,7000,9999} = zones 4/5/6/7A/7B/8; lookup rule (legacy-exact): first value where hdd < key, fallback 0.110

reference_envelope.note: populated fully in P4 (lightweight layers from Note A-8.4.4.4.(1), air leakage from 8.4.3.3.(3))

article_coverage.note: Envelope-slice coverage; statuses flip as phases land; partial/not_implemented emit audit warnings.
